name: php
description: PHP 8.4 with nginx and Composer, and Node.js for frontend builds. Built from the repo's source with Dockerfile below.

laravel.detect: file artisan and composer.json require laravel/framework

symfony.detect: file bin/console and composer.json require symfony/framework-bundle or symfony/symfony

php.detect: composer.json or index.php, when no other framework matched

placeholders.NODE_APK_PACKAGES: exact Alpine nodejs and npm versions
placeholders.DOC_ROOT_NOTE: a comment naming the public directory
placeholders.EXTRA_WRITABLE_DIRS: a RUN line making extra_writable_dirs writable, or nothing
